name: ohmygame
description: An open-source local-first agent for creating and publishing games.
author: WhiteTowerAI

scripts.build: npm run build:node && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:player
scripts.build:daemon: npm run build:node && npm run build:player
scripts.build:desktop-app: npm run clean:desktop-build && npm run prepare:preinstalled-plugins && npm run build:node && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:player
scripts.dev: npm run build:player && concurrently --kill-others --names daemon,renderer --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm:dev:daemon" "npm:dev:renderer"
scripts.dev:daemon: npm run prepare:preinstalled-plugins && tsx watch src/daemon/server.ts
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run prepare:preinstalled-plugins && npm run build:node && npm run build:player && concurrently --kill-others --names renderer,desktop --prefix-colors green,cyan "npm:dev:renderer" "electron ."
scripts.start:desktop: npm run prepare:preinstalled-plugins && npm run build:node && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:player && electron . --built-renderer
scripts.package:mac:dir: npm run prepare:desktop-runtime -- darwin-arm64 && npm run build:desktop-app && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --config.mac.notarize=false --config.mac.identity=null
scripts.package:mac: npm run prepare:desktop-runtime -- darwin-arm64 && npm run build:desktop-app && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.package:win: npm run prepare:desktop-runtime -- win32-x64 && npm run build:desktop-app && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
